Title: Enable MFA (hardware preferred) on the root account
Remediation steps: 1) Sign in as root. 2) Register a hardware or virtual MFA device. 3) Confirm no root access keys exist (none today). 4) Store root credentials offline.
Definition of done / verification: Prowler iam_root_mfa_enabled and iam_root_hardware_mfa_enabled PASS (hardware check passes only with a hardware key; otherwise record as accepted).
Status: Applied - hardware check PASS; root MFA row pending credential-report refresh

Title: Enforce MFA on cloud-project-admin and remove its direct AdministratorAccess attachment
Remediation steps: 1) Register MFA for the user. 2) Move AdministratorAccess to a group or role used only for the build. 3) Detach or disable the user after the sandbox is destroyed (Day 10).
Definition of done / verification: Prowler iam_user_mfa_enabled_console_access PASS for the user. Direct-attachment row clears.
Status: Applied - direct attachment PASS; MFA row pending credential-report refresh

Title: Replace wildcard IAM policies and delete the standing admin access key on misconfig-sandbox-admin-user
Remediation steps: 1) Delete the access key. 2) Remove the inline wildcard policy. 3) Replace the *:* managed policy with a scoped least-privilege policy, or delete the user. 4) Attach policies to a group or role. 5) Update Terraform so the next apply does not recreate them.
Definition of done / verification: Prowler iam_customer_attached_policy_no_administrative_privileges and the two direct-attachment rows PASS. No active access key on the user.

Title: Block public access on the sandbox bucket; remove public policy and ACL
Remediation steps: 1) Enable all four Block Public Access settings on the bucket. 2) Delete the PublicRead bucket policy. 3) Set the ACL to private. 4) Update Terraform.
Definition of done / verification: Prowler s3_bucket_level_public_access_block PASS. Anonymous GET on the bucket returns 403.

Title: Add MFA and external-ID conditions to the AdministratorAccess sandbox role, or scope its permissions
Remediation steps: 1) Add an aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent condition to the trust policy. 2) Replace AdministratorAccess with a scoped policy. 3) Update Terraform.

Title: Enable account-level S3 Block Public Access
Remediation steps: 1) Enable all four account-level settings with s3control put-public-access-block. 2) Confirm no legitimate public bucket depends on it.

Title: Enforce MFA on scanner-identity console login
Remediation steps: 1) Register MFA, or remove the console password since the identity only needs CLI access. Removing the password is the lower-friction option.
Definition of done / verification: Prowler iam_user_mfa_enabled_console_access PASS for the user.

Title: Enforce MFA on cloudproject and move its IAMReadOnlyAccess to a group
Remediation steps: 1) Register MFA. 2) Attach the policy through a group.
Definition of done / verification: Prowler iam_user_mfa_enabled_console_access and the direct-attachment row PASS.
Status: Partially applied - MFA pending credential-report refresh; direct policy attachment still open

Title: Close internet-open rules on sandbox security group sg-021c7366dcb131981
Remediation steps: 1) Remove the 0.0.0.0/0 rules for all ports, 22, 3389, 3306 and 5432. 2) Allow only a named admin CIDR if access is needed. 3) Update Terraform. 4) Delete the group if unused.
Definition of done / verification: Prowler ec2_securitygroup_allow_ingress_from_internet_to_all_ports PASS and ScoutSuite SSH, RDP, MySQL, PostgreSQL and all-ports rules clear. The per-rule check matters because Prowler's port-specific checks passed before the fix.

Title: Harden CloudTrail, send it to CloudWatch, add CIS alarms, enable Config and VPC flow logs
Prowler checks (counted rows): 20 checks across cloudtrail, cloudwatch, config, vpc (21 rows)
Remediation steps: 1) Enable log file validation and KMS encryption on the trail. 2) Add a CloudWatch Logs group and role. 3) Create the CIS section 4 metric filters and alarms. 4) Enable access logging on the trail bucket. 5) Enable the AWS Config recorder. 6) Enable flow logs on both VPCs. 7) Make the trail multi-region.
Definition of done / verification: All 21 Prowler rows PASS, including the 15 CloudWatch checks.

Strengthen the account password policy (14+ characters, 24-password history)
